The '''Queen's Monument''' was a bubble structure built by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. The structure was built to honor [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] for her efforts in building [[New Otoh Gunga]]. The bright purple light at the top of the monument represented the peace between the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. The five rotational lights at the bottom symbolized the Queen's strength, wisdom, beauty, compassion, and leadership.
